title: Gift of Membri

fields.label: Function
fields.value: When opened it gives one of the skeletal limbs

body:
"Warning: Whispers are a normal side effect of owning said box"

Description

The Gift of Membri was an item available for purchase at Ghoulish Goods for 4,199 Candy.

As of October 31st, 2023 the giftbox can now be opened and reveal one of four different skeletal limbs.

Appearance

This item's giftbox uses the Opened Gift of the Count's Coffin as it's model, while it's unboxed form uses the Roblox Skeleton bundle limbs.
